title: MetaAct: Self-Evolving Executable Action Constraints for Embodied Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.20655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving language agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for continuously improving agent behavior through experience. However, most existing approaches evolve textual artifacts, which can influence action preferences but cannot reliably enforce action admissibility in embodied environments with discrete and often irreversible actions. We propose MetaAct, which shifts self-evolution from textual guidance to executable action constraints by synthesizing GEAR (Grounded Executable Action Rules) from execution feedback. Each rule is represented as a typed specification, compiled into a deterministic guard, and validated offline through trajectory replay without additional model calls or environment interactions. Across four benchmarks, MetaAct improves task performance; on ScienceWorld and WebShop, violations drop from 70% to 0% and 40% to 1%, with score gains of +10.1 and +8.0. Our code is available at https://github.com/BaiCubed/

translated_title: MetaAct：面向具身语言智能体的自进化可执行动作约束
translated_abstract: 自进化语言智能体已成为一种有前景的范式，能够通过经验持续改进智能体行为。然而，现有的大多数方法只进化文本产物，这虽然可以影响动作偏好，却无法在具有离散且往往不可逆动作的具身环境中可靠地保证动作的可执行合法性。我们提出 MetaAct，将自我进化从文本引导转变为可执行的动作约束，通过执行反馈合成 GEAR（接地可执行动作规则，Grounded Executable Action Rules）。每条规则以带类型的规范形式表示，编译为确定性的守卫（guard），并通过轨迹回放进行离线验证，无需额外的模型调用或环境交互。在四个基准测试中，MetaAct 提升了任务性能；在 ScienceWorld 和 WebShop 上，违规率分别从 70% 降至 0%、从 40% 降至 1%，得分分别提升 +10.1 和 +8.0。
tldr: MetaAct 通过从执行反馈中合成可执行动作规则（GEAR）并编译为确定性守卫，将语言智能体的自进化从文本引导升级为可执行动作约束，在多个具身环境基准上大幅降低动作违规率并显著提升任务性能。
en_tdlr: MetaAct shifts the self-evolution of embodied language agents from textual guidance to executable action constraints by synthesizing Grounded Executable Action Rules (GEAR) from execution feedback, dramatically reducing action violations and improving task performance across benchmarks.
